usedFor: Espo CRM holds leads, and Google Drive receives files through “Copy a File” and “Share File” for each lead.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Espo CRM, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new lead can get its own copy of a template file in a chosen folder.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive opens a file to anyone with the link, so prefer Viewer access.
